title: What If the Next Cascadia Earthquake Hit Tomorrow?

scenes.text: What if the Cascadia earthquake hit tomorrow? The last one shook two oceans.
In January 1700, a magnitude 9 quake struck the Pacific Northwest. Japan was hit by a tsunami with no earthquake beforehand.
A repeat would shake for about four to six minutes, far longer than most earthquakes.
Parts of the coast could drop by roughly six feet, about two meters, in one event.
Tsunami waves could arrive in as little as 15 to 30 minutes, and the first wave may not be the biggest.
Scientists count at least 19 magnitude 9 quakes here in 10,000 years. It has been over 300 years. The next one can come any time.

description:
What if the next Cascadia earthquake hit tomorrow?
A magnitude 9 quake could shake for minutes and send a tsunami ashore in as little as 15 minutes.
